releaseNotes: Added Full Screen Play option to IPTV Live TV Player and Online Link Video Player with top-right overlay button, control bar toggle, channel list quick-launch, and URL bar Full Screen Play button.

Added auto-hiding Full Screen OSD controls, double-click fullscreen toggle, keyboard/remote shortcuts (F, Back/Esc to exit fullscreen, ChannelUp/ChannelDown), and native Android WebView WebChromeClient fullscreen support.
Added Advanced TV Compatibility Checker in Settings with real decoder, HDR, refresh rate, RAM, storage, and HOME launcher diagnostics.
Added Automatic Error Detection & Safe Auto-Repair engine for IPTV playlists, network endpoints, and launcher state.
Added Universal QR Code URL Input System with authenticated local LAN/relay sessions for M3U, Online Video, GitHub Repo, and Backup URLs.
Integrated Indian-IPTV-App (kananinirav/Indian-IPTV-App) stream catalog, multi-playlist manager, favorites, recently watched, and HLS.js recovery.
